dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250829-PAK-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250829-PAK-00) A flood occurred on Aug 29 2025 in Pakistan. It affected an estimated 5949956 people and 892075 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
